title: Sepsis-3: qSOFA bedside criteria
applicability: Adults with suspected infection outside ICU
text: qSOFA is a bedside prompt for possible poor outcomes in suspected infection. Its criteria are respiratory rate at least 22/min, altered mentation, and systolic blood pressure at most 100 mm Hg. Use it as supporting context, not as a standalone diagnosis or automated treatment order.

title: Sepsis-3 consensus definition
locator: JAMA 315(8), pp. 801-810; New Terms and Definitions
text: The consensus defines sepsis as life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection. It operationalises organ dysfunction as an acute SOFA increase of 2 or more. The copilot must present this as retrieved evidence, not diagnose sepsis.

title: National Early Warning Score 2
locator: RCP NEWS2 report, 2017; scoring charts and Scale 2 guidance
applicability: Adults; follow local adoption and exclusions
text: NEWS2 is a standardised aggregate score based on routinely recorded physiological parameters. It includes a designated oxygen-saturation scale for selected patients with hypercapnic respiratory failure. Apply the complete published chart and local policy; this corpus record does not reproduce a scoring chart.

title: NICE NG51 suspected sepsis
locator: NICE NG51 guideline landing page; verify current replacement/update status before clinical use
text: NICE guidance covers recognition, diagnosis, and early management of suspected sepsis. It must be used with the current NICE publication, local pathway, and patient-specific assessment. This indexed record is provenance for retrieval, not executable clinical policy.
